provenance: SYNTHETIC, NOT INDEPENDENT: eight simulated author profiles, sentences written, second-labelled and adjudicated by the language model that built the tooling; no person wrote, labelled or reviewed any row. Train profiles T1-T4 (plus the old template set), dev profiles DA and DB, test profiles TC and TD never overlap. A generalisation check across writing styles, not evidence about real trainee speech.
note: Credit needs the act to be neither NONE nor critical and its probability to reach the threshold; critical acts are recorded, never credited from speech. Deterministic action-based scoring stays authoritative.
